_comment: Brands Agent 0 (Intake) checked and rejected. Agent -1 reads this so a rejected brand does not climb the list again on the next weekly run. Ad data alone cannot see these -- only visiting the site can.
shopellox.com: Redirects to shoppaya.com, a general dropship store (hair clips, foot files, curtain rod brackets). Not a skincare brand; ran skincare-keyword ads only.
lovi.care: AI skincare app that scans faces and recommends other brands' products. No own product line -- different ICP from a DTC product brand.
dustrico.com: UPF sun-protective APPAREL — hoodies, hats, sunshirts, kids' adventure hoodies. Not skincare. Had ranked #9 in the fatigued segment on ad signals alone.
emuaid.com: OTC medicinal ointment marketed for 100+ skin CONDITIONS — fungal infections, psoriasis, shingles, lichen sclerosus, hemorrhoids. Regulated drug claims throughout. DESIGN.md §1 chose beauty/skincare specifically to avoid needing a compliance agent in v1; this is further outside that line than supplements.
trylumineskin.com: Redirects to hestiacosmetics.com — now a colour-changing foundation stick (makeup), not the skincare brand the ad data was measured against. Stale target: the 950 active ads were attributed to a brand that no longer exists at this domain.
